text:
Tower of amber walls,
+
+solitary laurel in a stone plaza,
+
+an unforeseen gulf,
+
+a smile in a dark corridor,
+
+the gait of a river flowing between palaces,
+
+sweet comet that blinds me and recedes…
+
+
+Bridge beneath whose arches life forever runs.

translation.title: Tower of Amber Walls…
translation.editorial_note: This distinct lineated witness of “Salvos” preserves the reviewed metaphoric sequence and its expanded pauses.
